title: n98-magerun2 database compatibility dataset
description: Versioned dataset describing which application (Magento Open Source / Adobe Commerce) versions officially support which database (MySQL / MariaDB) versions, consumed by the `db:compatibility` command. This is implemented and validated in PHP by N98\Util\Compatibility\Dataset\DatasetSchemaValidator.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the dataset was authored against.

datasetRevision.description: Monotonically increasing revision identifier for the dataset content itself, independent of schemaVersion.

publishedAt.description: Date the dataset revision was published.

freshnessPolicy.description: Documents how stale evidence is treated. Consumers should treat sources whose verifiedAt predates this window as insufficient for a conclusive assessment.

notes.description: Free-text maintenance notes shown to dataset maintainers, e.g. provenance/community-maintenance status.

sources.description: Authoritative references cited by applications[] and rules[].

applications.description: Declares, per product/edition/deployment-context/version-range scope, which database families are covered by rules[] and whether that coverage is exhaustive (i.e. whether an unmatched family/version may be treated as unsupported rather than unknown).

exhaustive.description: When true, a database family not listed in dbFamilyCoverage is reported as unsupported (not unknown) for this scope.

rules.description: Explicit support rules. A version pair is only ever "unsupported" via an explicit rule here, or because it falls inside an exhaustively-covered applications[] scope with no matching rule.

requirement.description: Human-readable explanation of the authoritative requirement backing this rule.

migrations.description: Migration guidance for database-family transitions (e.g. MySQL to MariaDB), independent of the support verdict.
